<b>Мультиполярный нейрон</b>: один аксон: Multipolar neuron: one axon and many dendrites, the most common type in the brain. This is a spinal cord motor neuron: its myelinated axon runs to a muscle, sometimes for more than a meter. The collateral branches off at a right angle and copies the signal to a second target.
<b>Псевдоуниполярный нейрон</b>: один ко: Pseudounipolar neuron: one short process near the cell body splits in the shape of a T (in development it is a bipolar neuron whose processes have fused). One branch runs to the skin, the other into the CNS; in fast touch fibers both are myelinated, and the signal bypasses the cell body.
<b>Клетка Пуркинье</b> мозжечка: с неё в: Purkinje cell of the cerebellum: neurocytology began with it in 1837. 2–3 thick dendrites leave the cell body and branch into a huge tree in a single plane. Motor memory is stored at its synapses. Turn the scene sideways, and the tree becomes a thin strip.
Сеть из пяти нейронов. <b>Сенсорный</b>: A network of five neurons. The sensory neuron (input) detects a touch on the skin, two interneurons pass the signal around a loop, and the muscle twitches several times. The motor neuron (output) controls the muscle. Transmitter: glutamate in central synapses, acetylcholine at the muscle.
<b>Окраска по Гольджи</b>: сначала бихро: Golgi stain: first potassium dichromate gives an orange background, then silver nitrate is added. Silver chromate forms, and the whole cell turns black, down to the finest dendritic twigs.
<b>Brainbow</b>: случайные сочетания флу: Brainbow: random combinations of fluorescent proteins from jellyfish and coral produce about 100 hues, so each cell can be traced through the tangle.
<b>Сердце.</b> Боль при стенокардии и ин: Heart. Angina and heart-attack pain is felt behind the breastbone and on the left, spreading to the left arm (along the inner side), the neck and the lower jaw. Sensory fibers from the heart enter the spinal cord at T1–T4, where nerves from the skin of the chest and the inner side of the arm also arrive (T1–T2, and C8 at the little finger). The neck and jaw: via the vagus nerve and the cervical segments.
<b>Почему боль «переезжает».</b> Волокна: Why pain “moves”. Fibers from the heart (red impulse) run through the sympathetic trunk and the white ramus into the spinal nerve; the neuron cell bodies lie in the dorsal root ganglion. In the dorsal horn they converge with fibers from the skin (blue impulse) on one neuron whose axon goes to the thalamus. The brain is used to signals from the skin and attributes the pain to it.
<b>Трубчатая кость</b> (схема бедренной): A long bone (here a schematic femur) cut lengthwise. The diaphysis is a wall of compact bone around a canal with yellow marrow. The epiphyses are a thin shell and spongy bone of trabeculae with red marrow. The ends are covered with hyaline cartilage, the rest with periosteum. The white line is the growth plate; the frame marks where the osteons are taken from.
<b>Остеон</b> (гаверсова система) — един: An osteon (Haversian system) is the unit of compact bone: 4–20 concentric lamellae of collagen and mineral around a central canal with a capillary and a nerve. In the lacunae between them sit osteocytes (purple), linked by their processes to each other and to the canal. Volkmann’s canals bring vessels from the periosteum. Bone is 2/3 mineral and 1/3 collagen.
<b>Остеопороз</b>: остеокласты разрушают: Osteoporosis: osteoclasts break bone down faster than osteoblasts build it (menopause, glucocorticoids). There are fewer trabeculae, they are thinner, the compact layer is thinned and the osteon canals are wider. Typical fractures — femoral neck, vertebrae, distal radius. Diagnosis — densitometry; treatment — calcium with vitamin D, bisphosphonates.
<b>Синовиальный сустав</b> на срезе. Кон: A synovial joint in section. The congruent surfaces are covered with smooth hyaline cartilage (blue), which is nourished by the synovial fluid; friction in it is lower than ice on ice. The fluid is produced by the synovial membrane (pink). The fibrous capsule continues into the periosteum, and ligaments lie outside it.
<b>Остеоартроз</b> — самая частая болезн: Osteoarthritis is the most common joint disease: cartilage wears away (age, injuries, excess weight), the joint space narrows, bone beneath the cartilage becomes denser, and bony spurs — osteophytes — grow at the margins. Movement is limited, there is crepitus, pain on loading, and brief morning stiffness. Treatment — exercise, weight loss, painkillers, and joint replacement when the joint is destroyed.
<b>Ревматоидный артрит</b> — аутоиммунно: Rheumatoid arthritis is autoimmune inflammation of the synovial membrane: it grows into pannus (red), which creeps over the cartilage and eats into the bone (erosions). There is an effusion, the joint is swollen and hot, morning stiffness lasts more than an hour; small joints of the hands and feet are affected symmetrically. Treatment — methotrexate and biologic drugs.
<b>Подагра</b>: при уровне урата выше ~4: Gout: when urate exceeds about 420 µmol/L, needle-shaped crystals of sodium urate (white) precipitate in the joint fluid. Neutrophils attack them, and overnight intense inflammation develops — most often in the big toe joint. The crystals show negative birefringence; in chronic gout nodules (tophi) form.
<b>Мыщелковый сустав</b> — два округлых: A condylar joint — two rounded condyles on almost flat facets: flexion–extension, and rotation too when flexed (two axes). The main example is the knee, the largest joint in the body: its surfaces do not match, so cartilaginous menisci lie between them, and cruciate ligaments inside.
Поперечный срез (спинная сторона сверху): A cross-section of the cord (dorsal side up). The gray matter looks like a butterfly: thin posterior horns, thick anterior horns, lateral horns between them. White matter with its tracts surrounds it. Sensory fibers enter by the posterior root, with a ganglion of pseudounipolar neurons; motor axons leave by the anterior root.
Tracts, numbered on the section. Blue and green are ascending: 1 and 2 — fibers from the legs and from the arms, 3 and 4 — to the cerebellum, 5 and 6 — spinothalamic (pain, temperature). Red and orange are descending: 7 and 8 — pyramidal (voluntary movement), 9–13 — the ancient extrapyramidal tracts.
<b>31 сегмент</b>: 8 шейных, 12 грудных,: 31 segments: 8 cervical, 12 thoracic, 5 lumbar, 5 sacral and one coccygeal; each gives off a pair of nerves. The spine grows faster than the cord, so in an adult the cord ends at the second lumbar vertebra and the roots below it run down as the cauda equina. A lumbar puncture is done below, in the lumbar cistern.
<b>Периферический нерв в разрезе.</b> Не: A peripheral nerve in cross-section. A nerve is a cable of thousands of axons. Each fiber is wrapped in endoneurium, fascicles in perineurium (the blood–nerve barrier), the whole nerve in epineurium with fat and vessels. The white sleeves are myelin of Schwann cells. After injury axons regrow about 1 mm a day.
<b>Коленный рефлекс</b> — моносинаптичес: The knee-jerk reflex is a monosynaptic arc. The hammer stretches the quadriceps, and the muscle spindle fires. The impulse runs through the ganglion and the posterior root straight to a motor neuron of the anterior horn: one synapse only. The muscle contracts: the fastest reflex, it maintains posture.
<b>Отдёргивание</b> — полисинаптический: The withdrawal reflex is polysynaptic. Prick → pain ending → ganglion → interneurons → flexor motor neurons. At the same time the signal crosses to the other side and ascends to the thalamus (red tail going up): we become aware of the pain only after the hand has already been pulled away.
<b>Мозг тормозит рефлекс.</b> На вставоч: The brain inhibits the reflex. Axons from the brain (blue signal from above) reach the interneuron. If an inhibitory signal arrives in time, the hand stays put: this is how we hold still while blood is taken from a finger. The knee-jerk reflex has no such interneuron, so it is much harder to suppress.
<b>Вегетативная дуга</b> из двух нейроно: An autonomic arc of two neurons. A preganglionic neuron of the lateral horn sends its axon through the anterior root and the white ramus to a sympathetic ganglion. There a postganglionic neuron sends its axon along the gray ramus into the nerve, to vessels, sweat glands and hair muscles. Sympathetic neurons exist only in segments T1–L2.
<b>Повреждён перекрёст (хиазма).</b> Рву: Optic chiasm damaged. The fibers from the nasal halves of the retinas are cut — they see the temporal halves of the field. Both outer halves drop out: bitemporal hemianopia (“blinkered vision”). A frequent cause is a pituitary tumor, which lies just below the chiasm.
<b>…</b>: The sexual response cycle is the sequence of changes in the body described by Masters and Johnson (1966): excitement → plateau → orgasm → resolution. It is controlled by the brain (cortex, limbic system, hypothalamus) and the autonomic nervous system: the parasympathetic division (green, sacral) for blood inflow, the sympathetic division (red, thoracolumbar) for orgasm.
<b>Сахар крови.</b> После еды глюкоза ра: Blood sugar. After a meal blood glucose rises (yellow line) → beta cells release insulin → the liver and muscles take up glucose and store it as glycogen → the level falls back to 4–6 mmol/L. When sugar is low, alpha cells release glucagon and the liver gives glucose back. This is negative feedback.
<b>Стресс.</b> Быстро: симпатические нер: Stress. Fast: sympathetic nerves → adrenal medulla → adrenaline within seconds: the heart speeds up, the liver dumps glucose. Slow: hypothalamus (CRH) → pituitary (ACTH) → adrenal cortex → cortisol, which keeps the body mobilized for hours.
<b>Ось «гипоталамус — гипофиз — щитовидн: The hypothalamus–pituitary–thyroid axis. TRH → pituitary TSH (purple particles) → the gland releases T4 and T3 (green). Their excess inhibits the hypothalamus and pituitary (red particles): negative feedback keeps the level constant. Click “Low iodine”.
<b>Гипоталамус</b> связывает нервную и э: The hypothalamus links the nervous and endocrine systems: it makes releasing hormones. The pituitary (0.5 g): the anterior lobe releases tropic hormones, the posterior stores hypothalamic ADH and oxytocin.
<b>Щитовидная железа</b> — «бабочка» на: The thyroid is a “butterfly” on the front of the neck. Thyroxine (T4) and triiodothyronine (T3) contain iodine, set the metabolic rate in almost all cells, and in children are needed for brain development. Calcitonin lowers blood calcium.
<b>Островки Лангерганса</b> — 1–2% ткани: The islets of Langerhans are 1–2% of the pancreas, about a million clusters of cells. Beta cells release insulin (opens cells to glucose), alpha cells — glucagon (the liver releases glucose). Lack of insulin means diabetes.
The heart is also an endocrine organ. Atria stretched by blood release natriuretic peptide: the kidneys excrete more salt and water, and pressure falls. A test for the related peptide BNP helps detect heart failure.
<b>Почки</b> выделяют <b>эритропоэтин</b: The kidneys release erythropoietin (the bone marrow makes more red cells), renin (starts the renin–angiotensin–aldosterone system that raises pressure) and turn vitamin D into calcitriol, which boosts calcium absorption.
<b>Желудок и кишка</b> — крупнейшая эндо: The stomach and gut are the largest endocrine “gland”: the lining releases gastrin, secretin, CCK, GIP and GLP-1 (boost insulin release; GLP-1 is the basis of diabetes drugs) and ghrelin.
<b>Жировая ткань</b> выделяет <b>лептин<: Fat tissue releases leptin: the more fat, the more leptin and the harder the hypothalamus suppresses appetite; in obesity the brain stops hearing this signal. Adiponectin raises insulin sensitivity.
<b>Лимфатическая и иммунная система.</b>: The lymphatic and immune system. The bone marrow and thymus are the central organs: lymphocytes mature there. The lymph nodes, spleen, tonsils and gut-associated lymphoid tissue are peripheral: lymphocytes meet invaders there. Green particles are lymph. Click an organ.
<b>Лимфатический узел.</b> Лимфа входит: Lymph node. Lymph enters through afferent vessels (the convex side), passes through the node and leaves through the efferent vessel at the hilum. In the cortex are follicles with B lymphocytes (blue), deeper the T zone (green), in the center the medullary cords. Macrophages (purple) eat what is unneeded.
<b>Антитела.</b> B-лимфоциты размножаютс: Antibodies. B lymphocytes multiply and become plasma cells that release thousands of antibodies a second (yellow Ys). Antibodies clump bacteria and tag them for macrophages. At the first encounter this takes 1–2 weeks — which is why we get sick. Some cells remain as memory cells.
<b>Лимфатические сосуды</b> собирают из: Lymphatic vessels collect fluid that has left the capillaries (2–3 L a day) along with proteins, fats from the gut and microbes. Lymph flows slowly and only toward the heart: muscles push it, and valves stop backflow. The thoracic duct drains into the left subclavian vein.
<b>Лимфоидная ткань кишки</b> — самая бо: Gut-associated lymphoid tissue is the largest part of the immune system: the gut wall holds more lymphocytes than all the lymph nodes. In the ileum its clusters are Peyer’s patches: M cells let samples of gut contents through, and the immune system learns to tell food from pathogens.
<b>Лейкоциты</b> — белые клетки с ядром,: Leukocytes are white cells with a nucleus, 4–9 thousand per µL. Neutrophils (up to 70%, segmented nucleus) are the first to reach an infection and eat bacteria. Lymphocytes (round nucleus) are B, T and NK cells. Monocytes (bean-shaped nucleus) become macrophages. Eosinophils (orange granules) fight parasites, basophils release histamine.
<b>Эритроциты</b> — двояковогнутые диски: Red blood cells are biconcave discs 7–8 µm across, nucleus-free and packed with hemoglobin. They carry oxygen from the lungs to the tissues and part of the CO₂ back. 4–5 million per µL, they live about 120 days and die in the spleen and liver; the marrow makes about 2 million new ones every second. Being flexible, they squeeze through capillaries narrower than themselves.
<b>Кровь в пробирке.</b> Если пробирку с: Blood in a test tube. Spin a tube of blood in a centrifuge and the cells settle: heavy red cells at the bottom (about 45% of the volume — the hematocrit), a thin whitish film of white cells and platelets above them (under 1%), and clear yellow plasma on top (about 55%). A low hematocrit points to anemia, a high one to thickened blood.
<b>Цикл полового ответа</b> — последоват: The sexual response cycle is the sequence of changes in the body described by Masters and Johnson (1966): excitement → plateau → orgasm → resolution. It is controlled by the brain (cortex, limbic system, hypothalamus) and the autonomic nervous system: the parasympathetic division (green, sacral) for blood inflow, the sympathetic division (red, thoracolumbar) for orgasm.
<b>Синдром Кушинга</b> — избыток кортизо: Cushing’s syndrome is an excess of cortisol (glucocorticoid drugs, an adrenal or pituitary tumor). Here it is an adrenal tumor: ACTH is suppressed (with a pituitary tumor it is high). Glucose above normal, fat on the face and trunk with thin limbs, stretch marks, osteoporosis, hypertension, weak immunity.
<b>Как стероид включает ген.</b> Стероид: How a steroid switches on a gene. Steroids are fat-soluble and cross the membrane on their own; inside, a nuclear receptor waits for them. Here is its ligand-binding domain (the progesterone receptor, PDB 1A28). The hormone closes the pocket with helix 12 (pink), a coactivator (violet) sits on it, and the receptor switches on genes. Cortisol and other steroid receptors work the same way.
<b>Кортизол</b> действует через рецептор: Cortisol acts through the GR receptor, a relative of the one shown. But the aldosterone receptor (MR) binds it just as tightly, and there is hundreds of times more cortisol in the blood! In the kidney MR is protected by the enzyme 11β-HSD2, which turns cortisol into inactive cortisone. Glycyrrhizin from licorice blocks it — cortisol switches on MR and blood pressure rises.
<b>Врождённая гиперплазия коры</b> (дефи: Congenital adrenal hyperplasia (21-hydroxylase deficiency, about 1 in 10–15 thousand newborns). Cortisol is low, and in ~3/4 of patients so is aldosterone (salt loss). 17-OH-progesterone builds up (the basis of the diagnosis) and is shunted into androgens; the pituitary drives ACTH and the cortex grows. Treatment: hydrocortisone and fludrocortisone.
<b>Липолиз в жировой клетке.</b> Почти в: Lipolysis in a fat cell. A droplet of triacylglycerols fills almost the whole adipocyte. In fasting, epinephrine (and, more weakly, glucagon) acts through cAMP and protein kinase A to switch on hormone-sensitive TAG lipase (blue). Fatty acids leave in the blood bound to albumin, glycerol goes to the liver for gluconeogenesis. Turn on “Insulin” — lipolysis stops.
<b>β-Окисление в митохондрии.</b> Жирная: β-Oxidation in the mitochondrion. A fatty acid is activated in the cytoplasm (acyl-CoA, costs ATP) and enters the matrix via the carnitine shuttle (purple). There a cycle of 4 reactions runs: oxidation (FAD) → hydration → oxidation (NAD⁺) → thiolysis — each turn cuts off 2 carbons as acetyl-CoA and yields FADH₂ and NADH. Palmitate (C16): 7 turns, 8 acetyl-CoA.
<b>Кетоновые тела</b> — ацетоацетат, β-г: Ketone bodies — acetoacetate, β-hydroxybutyrate and acetone — are made only by the liver, when fat gives a lot of acetyl-CoA and oxaloacetate has gone to gluconeogenesis (fasting, diabetes). The liver cannot use them: they travel in the blood to the brain (after 2–3 weeks of fasting up to 2/3 of its energy), heart and muscle. Acetone is exhaled. Time is sped up: watch 40 days of fasting.
<b>Синтез жирных кислот</b> идёт в цитоп: Fatty acid synthesis takes place in the cytoplasm after a meal. Acetyl-CoA leaves the mitochondrion as citrate; acetyl-CoA carboxylase (yellow) makes malonyl-CoA — the key step (switched on by insulin and citrate). Fatty acid synthase (blue) lengthens the chain by 2 carbons in 7 cycles up to palmitate C16, spending 2 NADPH (green) per cycle.
<b>Ворсинки тонкой кишки.</b> Слизистая: Villi of the small intestine. The mucosa is gathered into folds, the folds are covered with villi (≈1 mm), and the villus cells carry microvilli (right): the absorptive area grows to ~30 m². Glucose and amino acids (yellow and green) enter the capillaries and travel via the portal vein to the liver. Fats (white) go into the lacteal — a lymphatic capillary — and then into the lymph.
<b>Половое влечение (либидо)</b> рождает: Sex drive (libido) arises from the interplay of the brain and hormones: the hypothalamus and pituitary control the gonads, and their hormones return to the brain; dopamine creates motivation, and the prefrontal cortex assesses the situation. The strength of desire is individual, and its absence (asexuality) is a normal variant. Choose a state.
<b>ИППП</b> — инфекции, передающиеся пол: STIs are sexually transmitted infections. Many go without symptoms for a long time, so you may not know you are infected and may infect others. Protection: condoms, vaccines (HPV, hepatitis B), regular testing, treatment of both partners, HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis. Bacteria are larger than viruses. Click a pathogen.
<b>Контрацепция.</b> Столбец — сколько ж: Contraception. The bar shows how many women out of 100 become pregnant in a year with typical use. The green ring means the method also protects against STIs; of all methods, only the condom does. Consent must be voluntary and informed, and can be withdrawn at any moment; saying “no” is everyone’s right. In Russia the age of consent is 16.
<b>ВИЧ</b> поражает CD4-лимфоциты. Перед: HIV infects CD4 lymphocytes. It is transmitted by sex without a condom, through blood (shared needles) and from mother to child. It can cause no symptoms for years; untreated, it leads to AIDS. Therapy allows a full life, and with an undetectable viral load the virus is not passed to a partner. Pre-exposure prophylaxis exists.
<b>Толстая кишка</b> (около 1,5 м): слеп: The large intestine (about 1.5 m): the cecum with the appendix, the colon and the rectum. It absorbs water and salts and forms feces over 12–36 hours. Trillions of microbiota bacteria break down fiber and synthesize vitamin K and B vitamins. Three muscular bands (shown separately on the model) gather the wall into pouches, the haustra.
<b>Пенициллин в ферменте бактерии</b> (P: Penicillin in a bacterial enzyme (PDB 1PWC). Transpeptidase cross-links the bacterial wall. Penicillin resembles its substrate (D-Ala-D-Ala), but its strained β-lactam ring opens and binds covalently to the active-site serine: irreversible inhibition. The wall is not completed and the bacterium bursts.
<b>Дигидрофолатредуктаза с НАДФН</b> (PD: Dihydrofolate reductase with NADPH (PDB 1RX1) reduces dihydrofolate (a form of vitamin B9) to tetrahydrofolate, without which DNA nucleotides cannot be made. Methotrexate (the yellow molecule) is a folate analogue: a competitive inhibitor bound thousands of times tighter than the substrate. It halts the division of fast-growing cells (tumors, rheumatoid arthritis).
<b>Аллостерическая регуляция.</b> Кроме: Allosteric regulation. Besides the active sites, a regulatory enzyme has an allosteric site (the ring in the middle) for an effector that does not resemble the substrate. Subunits influence one another (cooperativity), so the rate follows an S-shaped curve. An activator (AMP) shifts it left, an inhibitor (ATP) shifts it right.
<b>Фосфорилирование</b> — самый частый в: Phosphorylation is the most common enzyme switch: a kinase moves phosphate from ATP onto serine, threonine or tyrosine, a phosphatase removes it. On the left is Src tyrosine kinase (PDB 2SRC): the phosphate on its tail (Tyr527, the glowing dot) snaps into the SH2 pocket and switches it off. On the right is lipase: phosphate switches it on (adrenaline → fat breakdown).
<b>Частичный протеолиз.</b> Протеазы син: Partial proteolysis. Proteases are made inactive, as proenzymes, so they do not digest their own cell. Cutting off a piece of chain (the pale peptide) changes the protein's shape: the new N-terminus tucks inside and assembles the catalytic triad His57, Asp102, Ser195 (glowing dots). This is how trypsin and clotting factors switch on. The model is factor Xa.
<b>Лактатдегидрогеназа</b> — тетрамер из: Lactate dehydrogenase is a tetramer of H subunits (heart, blue) and M subunits (muscle, liver, red): five combinations give the isozymes LDH1 (H4) … LDH5 (M4), which move differently in an electric field. Normally LDH2 > LDH1; in myocardial infarction LDH1 overtakes LDH2, in liver damage LDH5 rises. This is the basis of enzyme diagnostics.
<b>Витамин B1 (тиамин).</b> Кофермент —: Vitamin B1 (thiamine). Its coenzyme is thiamine pyrophosphate: enzymes that remove CO₂ from keto acids (pyruvate and α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase) need it. Deficiency causes beriberi (polyneuritis, heart failure). Sources: grain husks, yeast, pork.
<b>Витамин B2 (рибофлавин)</b> — жёлтый: Vitamin B2 (riboflavin) is a yellow pigment. Its forms FMN and FAD are prosthetic groups of flavoproteins: succinate dehydrogenase, acyl-CoA dehydrogenase, complex I. The ring accepts two hydrogen atoms. Deficiency: cracks at the corners of the mouth, glossitis. Sources: milk, eggs, liver.
<b>Витамин PP (B3, ниацин)</b> входит в: Vitamin PP (B3, niacin) is part of NAD⁺ and NADP⁺, carriers of the hydride ion for hundreds of dehydrogenases. A little niacin is made from tryptophan. Deficiency — pellagra (the “three Ds”: dermatitis, diarrhea, dementia). Sources: meat, fish, peanuts, mushrooms.
<b>Витамин B5 (пантотеновая кислота</b>,: Vitamin B5 (pantothenic acid, from Greek “pantos” — everywhere) is part of coenzyme A: its terminal SH group (yellow sulfur) carries acid residues. Acetyl-CoA is a crossroads of metabolism. Deficiency is almost unknown (“burning feet” in prisoners of war).
<b>Витамин B6.</b> Активная форма — <b>п: Vitamin B6. The active form is pyridoxal phosphate: its aldehyde group grips the amino group of an amino acid. The coenzyme of transaminases (ALT, AST) and decarboxylases (synthesis of GABA, serotonin, dopamine). Deficiency: seizures in infants, anemia. Sources: meat, fish, bananas.
<b>Биотин (витамин H, B7)</b> пришиваетс: Biotin (vitamin H, B7) is attached to a lysine of carboxylases and carries CO₂: pyruvate carboxylase (gluconeogenesis), acetyl-CoA carboxylase (fat synthesis). Gut bacteria make a lot of it. Deficiency can follow raw egg white: avidin binds biotin.
<b>Фолиевая кислота</b> (лат. folium — л: Folic acid (Latin folium — leaf). Its form tetrahydrofolate carries one-carbon groups for the synthesis of purines and thymidine (DNA doubling). Deficiency: megaloblastic anemia, neural tube defects in the fetus. Methotrexate (“Active form”) is its analogue (chemotherapy).
<b>Витамин B12 (кобаламин)</b> — самый с: Vitamin B12 (cobalamin) is the most complex vitamin; in the center of the corrin ring is cobalt (pink). It is needed to make methionine and to convert methylmalonyl-CoA to succinyl-CoA, and is absorbed with the intrinsic factor. Deficiency: pernicious anemia. Found only in animal foods.
<b>Витамин C</b> — восстановитель и анти: Vitamin C is a reducing agent and antioxidant. Prolyl and lysyl hydroxylases, which finish collagen, need it. Deficiency — scurvy: bleeding gums, poor wound healing. Humans cannot make it. Sources: rose hips, blackcurrant, peppers, citrus.
<b>Витамин A (ретинол).</b> Его альдегид: Vitamin A (retinol). Its aldehyde 11-cis-retinal is the light-sensitive part of rhodopsin (the “Vision” mode), and retinoic acid controls genes for epithelial growth. Deficiency: night blindness, dry eyes. Excess is toxic. Sources: liver, fish oil, β-carotene of carrots.
<b>Витамин D3 (холекальциферол)</b> обра: Vitamin D3 (cholecalciferol) forms in the skin under ultraviolet light. The liver (25-OH) and kidneys (1-OH) turn it into the hormone calcitriol (“Active form”), which boosts calcium absorption in the gut. Deficiency: rickets, osteomalacia. Sources: sunlight, fatty fish.
<b>Витамин E (токоферол)</b> — главный а: Vitamin E (tocopherol) is the main antioxidant of membranes. The long tail hides among fatty acids, while the ring with its OH group gives a hydrogen atom to a radical and breaks the chain peroxidation of lipids. Deficiency: red cell breakdown, neuropathy. Sources: oils, nuts.
<b>Витамин K</b> нужен ферменту, который: Vitamin K is needed by the enzyme that turns glutamate residues into γ-carboxyglutamate in clotting factors II, VII, IX, X: this lets them bind calcium. Deficiency — bleeding. Warfarin (“Active form”) is a vitamin K antagonist. Sources: green leaves, gut bacteria.
<b>НАД⁺ в работе.</b> Слева — вся молеку: NAD⁺ at work. On the left is the whole molecule: adenosine, two phosphates and nicotinamide (vitamin PP), the working part. In the active site of a dehydrogenase (here LDH) a hydride ion H⁻ (yellow glow) is taken from lactate and lands on the ring: NAD⁺ → NADH. On the graph NADH absorbs light at 340 nm and NAD⁺ does not — this is how enzyme activity is measured.
<b>Витамин A в зрении.</b> Структура <b>: Vitamin A in vision. The structure of rhodopsin (PDB 1U19), the protein of retinal rods: seven helices span the membrane, and in the middle lies 11-cis-retinal (the aldehyde of vitamin A). A photon straightens it into the all-trans form in 200 fs, and the protein starts the cascade. Then retinal is regenerated; without vitamin A, twilight vision suffers.
Тринадцать веществ, которые организм не: Thirteen substances the body cannot make on its own, or makes too little of. Most of them are parts of enzymes: without the vitamin, the enzyme does not work.
<b>АТФ — энергетическая валюта клетки.</: ATP is the energy currency of the cell. Adenine, ribose and three phosphates; the bonds between the phosphates are high-energy: hydrolysis of the terminal phosphate releases 30.5 kJ/mol. Water removes the phosphate (Pi), the energy goes to work, and ADP is “recharged” by the oxidation of food. On the graph ATP sits in the middle of the high-energy scale.
<b>Цикл трикарбоновых кислот</b> (цикл К: The tricarboxylic acid cycle (Krebs cycle) in the mitochondrial matrix is the “furnace” where the remnants of every kind of fuel are burned. Acetyl-CoA (C2) + oxaloacetate (C4) → citrate (C6); each turn releases 2 CO₂ and makes 3 NADH, 1 FADH₂ and 1 GTP. The gold beads, the coenzymes, fly to the respiratory chain (right). On the left is the PDH complex. Click a molecule.
<b>Пируватдегидрогеназный комплекс</b> —: The pyruvate dehydrogenase complex is a giant assembly (larger than a ribosome) of three enzymes: E1 (TPP — B1), E2 (lipoic acid, CoA — B5), E3 (FAD — B2, NAD⁺ — PP). Pyruvate + NAD⁺ + HS-CoA → acetyl-CoA + CO₂ + NADH. The reaction is irreversible: glucose cannot be made from acetyl-CoA. Inhibited by ATP, acetyl-CoA, NADH.
<b>Тканевое дыхание.</b> Водород с топли: Tissue respiration. Hydrogen from fuel (NADH, FADH₂) travels along a chain of carriers in the inner mitochondrial membrane to oxygen. The energy of the electrons (light blue) is spent on pumping protons (pink) outward — a gradient builds up (Mitchell’s theory). Protons return through ATP synthase and spin the rotor: ATP is made. Click a complex or a poison.
<b>Цианид, угарный газ, сероводород, ази: Cyanide, carbon monoxide, hydrogen sulfide and azide bind to the heme iron of cytochrome oxidase (complex IV). Oxygen cannot accept electrons, the chain stalls, no ATP is made — death within minutes. There is plenty of oxygen in the blood, but the cells cannot use it; carbon monoxide also displaces O₂ from hemoglobin.
<b>Разобщители</b> — 2,4-динитрофенол, б: Uncouplers — 2,4-dinitrophenol, large doses of aspirin, thyroxine, and the protein thermogenin of brown fat — carry protons back across the membrane, bypassing ATP synthase. Respiration speeds up, but almost no ATP is made: the energy is lost as heat. This is how newborns and hibernating animals keep warm; DNP was once sold “for weight loss” — people died of overheating.
<b>АТФ-синтаза (F₀F₁)</b> — роторный мот: ATP synthase (F₀F₁) is a rotary motor. Protons enter through subunit a (light blue), bind to the ring of c subunits (purple) and, turning it, exit into the matrix. The ring spins the γ shaft inside the F₁ head (α₃β₃): the three β subunits (gold) in turn bind ADP and Pi, squeeze them into ATP and release it. Up to 100 revolutions per second; ≈3 protons per ATP.
<b>Пентозофосфатный путь.</b> Глюкозо-6-: Pentose phosphate pathway. Glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase and the next enzymes give 2 NADPH, CO₂ and ribose-5-phosphate — the sugar for DNA, RNA and ATP. NADPH is needed for fat and cholesterol synthesis and protects against oxidants (glutathione). G6PD deficiency — in hundreds of millions of people — destroys red blood cells after fava beans or some drugs.
<b>Анаэробный гликолиз</b> идёт в цитопл: Anaerobic glycolysis takes place in the cytoplasm without oxygen: glucose → 2 lactate. Stage 1 (reactions 1–5) is the investment: 2 ATP to activate glucose and split it into two trioses. Stage 2 (6–10) is the payoff: 2 NADH and 4 ATP. Net: 2 ATP; NADH goes to reduce pyruvate to lactate, and the liver turns lactate back into glucose (the Cori cycle). Click a reaction arrow.
<b>Аэробный распад глюкозы.</b> Те же 10: Aerobic breakdown of glucose. The same 10 reactions up to pyruvate, but NADH passes its hydrogen to the respiratory chain (+6 ATP), and pyruvate burns in the mitochondria to CO₂ and H₂O (2 × 15 = 30 ATP). Total: 38 ATP per glucose (≈ 30–32 by current data) — 19 times more than without oxygen. So in air glucose use drops and lactate does not build up (the Pasteur effect).
<b>Глюконеогенез</b> — синтез глюкозы в: Gluconeogenesis makes glucose in the liver and kidneys from lactate, pyruvate, glycerol and amino acids during fasting. Seven glycolytic reactions are reversible and run backward; the three irreversible ones are bypassed by four enzymes (I–IV, red arrows). Cost: 4 ATP + 2 GTP + 2 NADH per glucose. Glucagon and cortisol switch it on, insulin inhibits it.
<b>Мембрана</b> — двойной слой фосфолипи: The membrane is a double layer of phospholipids — a real fragment from a molecular dynamics simulation: 128 phosphatidylcholine molecules (● phosphorus, ● nitrogen, ● oxygen; beige — tails). Heads face the water, tails hide inside; the thickness is about 4 nm. Between the lipids sits cholesterol (yellow), and the protein rhodopsin (PDB 1U19) spans the membrane. The membrane is fluid.
<b>Высшие жирные кислоты</b> — длинные у: Long-chain fatty acids are long hydrocarbon chains with a carboxyl group (at the top of the model — the red oxygen atoms). Saturated ones have no double bonds and are straight. Unsaturated ones contain double bonds; natural ones are in the cis form, with a kink. Click an acid.
<b>Переваривание жиров</b> идёт в тонкой: Fat digestion takes place in the small intestine. Bile acids (green) emulsify fat — they break a large droplet into small ones. Pancreatic lipase with colipase (pink) cleaves off fatty acids; together with bile acids they form micelles and are absorbed, and in the villus cells they are reassembled into chylomicrons and enter the lymph. Without bile — steatorrhea.
<b>Переваривание белков</b> — гидролиз п: Protein digestion is the hydrolysis of peptide bonds. A chain of multicolored amino acids is cut by endopeptidases: pepsin in the stomach, trypsin, chymotrypsin and elastase in the intestine. Then exopeptidases remove amino acids one by one from the ends, and they enter the portal vein. The proteases are made as inactive proenzymes, or they would digest the gland.
<b>Трансаминирование</b> — перенос амино: Transamination moves an amino group from an amino acid to an α-keto acid. ALT, with the coenzyme pyridoxal phosphate (B6), passes NH₂ (blue spark) from alanine to α-ketoglutarate: pyruvate and glutamate form. Glutamate dehydrogenase releases the nitrogen of glutamate as ammonia. Below — amines from decarboxylation: histamine, serotonin, GABA, dopamine.
<b>Орнитиновый цикл</b> (Кребс — Хензела: The ornithine cycle (Krebs–Henseleit) detoxifies ammonia and runs only in the liver. In the mitochondrion, NH₃ + CO₂ + 2 ATP → carbamoyl phosphate; with ornithine it gives citrulline. The second nitrogen is brought by aspartate → argininosuccinate → arginine (fumarate goes to the Krebs cycle). Arginase splits urea off (25–35 g a day) and returns ornithine. One turn costs 3 ATP.
<b>Фенилаланин и тирозин.</b> Фенилалани: Phenylalanine and tyrosine. Phenylalanine hydroxylase converts the essential phenylalanine into tyrosine; tyrosine gives the catecholamines (dopamine → norepinephrine → epinephrine), thyroxine and melanin, and the rest is broken down to fumarate and acetoacetate. Choose an inherited block.
<b>Фенилкетонурия</b> (≈ 1 на 7000 новор: Phenylketonuria (≈ 1 in 7000 newborns): phenylalanine hydroxylase is missing. Phenylalanine and phenylpyruvate (the “phenylketones” in the urine) build up and damage the brain. All newborns are screened in the first days; a phenylalanine-restricted diet from birth — and the child develops normally.
<b>Гистамин</b> образуется из гистидина: Histamine is made from histidine in mast cells and basophils. In allergy and inflammation it is released: it widens capillaries and makes them leakier (swelling, redness, hives), constricts the bronchi (H₁ receptors) and increases stomach acid secretion (H₂). Antihistamines block H₁ receptors.
<b>Серотонин</b>: триптофан → 5-гидрокси: Serotonin: tryptophan → 5-hydroxytryptophan → serotonin. About 90% of it is made by gut cells (motility); the rest by brainstem neurons (mood, sleep, appetite) and carried by platelets. In the pineal gland at night serotonin becomes melatonin, the hormone of darkness. SSRI antidepressants keep serotonin in synapses longer.
<b>Катехоламины</b>: тирозин → ДОФА (тир: Catecholamines: tyrosine → DOPA (tyrosine hydroxylase, the key enzyme) → dopamine → noradrenaline (needs vitamin C) → adrenaline. Dopamine is the transmitter of movement and motivation (in Parkinson’s disease L-DOPA is given: it enters the brain, dopamine does not); noradrenaline is the sympathetic transmitter; adrenaline is the stress hormone.
<b>Где работают амины.</b> Мозг — дофами: Where amines act. Brain: dopamine, serotonin, GABA, noradrenaline; pineal gland: melatonin; adrenal glands: adrenaline; mast cells of lungs and skin: histamine; gut: serotonin. The action is brief: amines are taken back up by nerve endings and broken down by monoamine oxidase (MAO) and COMT; the breakdown products leave in the urine.
<b>Глицин, серин и фолат.</b> Серин отда: Glycine, serine and folate. Serine gives its CH₂OH carbon to tetrahydrofolate (THF, vitamin B9) and becomes glycine. Methylene-THF is needed for thymidylate (DNA), formyl-THF for purines, and methyl-THF with vitamin B12 turns homocysteine into methionine (the source of SAM methyls). Switch on the deficiencies.
<b>Дефицит фолиевой кислоты.</b> Не хват: Folic acid deficiency. One-carbon units run short and cells cannot make DNA fast enough. Rapidly dividing cells suffer: the bone marrow produces large immature cells (megaloblastic anemia). In pregnancy the deficiency raises the risk of neural tube defects in the fetus.
<b>Метотрексат</b> похож на фолат и проч: Methotrexate resembles folate and firmly blocks dihydrofolate reductase: DHF is not converted to THF, and the synthesis of thymidylate and purines stops. Rapidly dividing tumor cells die; in small doses the drug helps in rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis. Trimethoprim blocks bacterial DHFR in the same way.
<b>Двойная спираль ДНК</b> (Уотсон и Кри: The DNA double helix (Watson and Crick, 1953) is the real structure of the Drew–Dickerson dodecamer (PDB 1BNA): each ball is an atom. Two antiparallel strands with a backbone of deoxyribose and phosphate (● phosphorus on the outside); the bases inside are joined by hydrogen bonds: A=T has two, G≡C three. The major and minor grooves are visible.
<b>Репликация</b> полуконсервативна: в к: Replication is semiconservative: each new DNA molecule has one old strand and one new one. Helicase unwinds the helix, primase lays down RNA primers, and DNA polymerase extends the chain only 5′→3′. The leading strand grows continuously, the lagging strand in Okazaki fragments (100–200 nucleotides) that ligase joins.
<b>Повреждение и репарация.</b> Ультрафи: Damage and repair. Ultraviolet light fuses two adjacent thymines (yellow glow) into a thymine dimer: the helix bends, and copying and reading of the gene break down. In excision repair a nuclease cuts out a stretch of the strand, DNA polymerase refills it using the intact strand, and ligase seals it. A defect of this system causes xeroderma pigmentosum.
<b>Транскрипция</b> — переписывание гена: Transcription copies a gene from DNA into RNA in the nucleus. RNA polymerase II (orange, PDB 5FLM) sits on the promoter (yellow zone, TATA box), unwinds about 14 base pairs and builds RNA 5′→3′ along the template strand (U instead of T). Above is the regulator protein GAL4 on its own stretch of DNA (PDB 1D66). Already during synthesis a cap (purple) is added to the 5′ end.
<b>Созревание мРНК</b> у эукариот. Смысл: mRNA maturation in eukaryotes. The coding exons (colored) are separated by introns (gray). The spliceosome cuts the introns out as a lariat and joins the exons (so one gene can give different mRNAs). The 5′ end carries a cap (purple), a poly-A tail (red) is added at the 3′ end, and the mature mRNA leaves through the nuclear pore.
<b>Трансляция</b> на рибосоме: модель —: Translation on the ribosome: the model is a bacterial 70S ribosome with mRNA and three tRNAs (PDB 1VY4; eukaryotes have 80S, the principle is the same). The tRNA anticodon (E turquoise, P lilac, A pink) pairs with the codon in the A site, the chain is transferred to the new amino acid, and the ribosome moves on by one codon. Switch on an antibiotic.
<b>Нуклеотид</b> = азотистое основание +: A nucleotide = a nitrogenous base + a pentose + phosphate (AMP at the bottom). Purines (adenine, guanine) have two rings, pyrimidines (cytosine, thymine, uracil) one. DNA has thymine, RNA has uracil. In the center is adenine, its atoms colored by origin: glycine, aspartate, glutamine, CO₂, formyl-THF.
<b>Распад пуринов.</b> АМФ → ИМФ → инози: Purine breakdown. AMP → IMP → inosine → hypoxanthine → xanthine → uric acid (the last two steps are catalyzed by xanthine oxidase); guanine also gives xanthine. Uric acid is poorly soluble: in excess its salt crystallizes in the joints — gout. Allopurinol (an analogue of hypoxanthine) inhibits xanthine oxidase.
<b>Синтез нуклеотидов и антиметаболиты.<: Nucleotide synthesis and antimetabolites. Nucleotides need tetrahydrofolate, which dihydrofolate reductase (DHFR, PDB 1RX1) regenerates. Chemotherapy is built on this: methotrexate, a folate analogue, occupies DHFR; 5-fluorouracil, a uracil analogue, blocks thymidylate synthase. A defect of the “salvage pathway” (HGPRT) causes Lesch–Nyhan syndrome.
<b>Серповидноклеточная анемия</b> (HbSS: Sickle cell anemia (HbSS — both copies of the gene are mutant). While oxygen is plentiful, the cells are normal. Once it gives up oxygen, hemoglobin S sticks together by its “sticky” valine into rigid fibers, and the cell becomes a sickle. Sickle cells get stuck in capillaries (pain, infarctions) and are rapidly destroyed.
<b>Частичный протеолиз</b>: проинсулин (: Partial proteolysis: proinsulin (a single chain) is cut in the secretory granules of β-cells — the C-peptide (gray) leaves, and chains A and B stay linked by disulfide bridges: that is insulin. The C-peptide level shows the body’s own insulin output. Digestive enzymes (trypsinogen), clotting factors and many hormones are activated the same way.
<b>Рецептор и цАМФ.</b> Адреналин садитс: Receptor and cAMP. Adrenaline binds the β2-adrenergic receptor (orange, structure 3SN6): Gαs (blue) switches on adenylyl cyclase (green), and ATP becomes cAMP. It starts protein kinase A, and that starts glycogen breakdown. Every step amplifies the signal: one hormone molecule — millions of glucose molecules. Phosphodiesterase (gray) switches cAMP off.
<b>Липофильные гормоны</b> (стероиды, ти: Lipophilic hormones (steroids, thyroid hormones, calcitriol) cross the membrane on their own. In the cytoplasm cortisol binds its receptor (pink), HSP90 (gray) comes off, the complex enters the nucleus and binds DNA response elements (HRE), switching genes on or off. The effect is slow (hours) but lasting. The DNA-binding domain is shown using GAL4 as an example (PDB 1D66).
<b>Инсулин</b> действует через <b>рецепт: Insulin acts through a receptor tyrosine kinase: two α subunits outside (blue) bind the hormone, two β subunits inside (purple) phosphorylate each other (kinase shown: Src, 2SRC). Through IRS, PI3-kinase and Akt the signal reaches vesicles with GLUT4 (green): they fuse with the membrane, and glucose enters the cell. In type 2 diabetes this chain falters.
<b>Гормоны по химическому строению.</b>: Hormones by chemical structure. Peptide hormones (insulin) and amino-acid derivatives (adrenaline, thyroxine) are hydrophilic and act through membrane receptors (thyroid hormones excepted). Steroids (cortisol, sex hormones, calcitriol) come from cholesterol, are lipophilic and act through the nucleus. Eicosanoids are local, from arachidonic acid. Click a molecule.
<b>Тироксин</b> — йодированное производн: Thyroxine is an iodinated tyrosine derivative (4 iodine atoms — purple). In cells it is converted to the more active T3, enters the nucleus and raises metabolism and heat production; it is needed for brain development. Deficiency — hypothyroidism (cretinism in children), excess — thyrotoxicosis. Without iodine — endemic goiter.
<b>Гипофиз</b> — железа с горошину под м: The pituitary is a pea-sized gland under the brain in the bony “sella turcica”; the hypothalamus controls it. In the anterior lobe five cell types make six hormones; releasing hormones switch them on and inhibiting hormones off (via the portal vessels). The posterior lobe makes no hormones: vasopressin and oxytocin arrive along hypothalamic axons. Choose a hormone.
<b>Соматотропный гормон</b> (СТГ, гормон: Growth hormone (GH, somatotropin) is a protein of 191 amino acids; it is made by somatotrophs, almost half of the anterior-lobe cells. Somatoliberin switches it on and somatostatin switches it off. It is released in pulses, most of all in deep sleep. It raises blood sugar and fat breakdown, while bones grow through IGF-1 from the liver (see “Growth hormone”).
<b>Пролактин</b> запускает выработку мол: Prolactin starts and maintains milk production. The hypothalamus mostly inhibits it: dopamine (red stream, molecule on the right) keeps lactotrophs “on the brake”. If drugs block dopamine or a tumor pinches the stalk, prolactin rises. A prolactinoma is the most common hormone-producing pituitary tumor; it is treated with dopamine agonists (cabergoline).
Кортикотрофы делают предшественник <b>пр: Corticotrophs make a large precursor protein, pro-opiomelanocortin (POMC, on the right): enzymes cut it into ACTH (switches on the adrenal cortex), MSH (skin pigmentation) and β-endorphin. Corticoliberin switches them on, cortisol inhibits by feedback. In Addison’s disease ACTH is high — and the skin darkens. A corticotroph adenoma causes Cushing’s disease.
<b>Тиреотропный гормон</b> (ТТГ) — глико: Thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) is a glycoprotein of two subunits: α is shared with LH, FSH and hCG, β is its own. It is switched on by thyroliberin (TRH, three amino acids, molecule on the right) and inhibited by somatostatin and thyroid hormones. TSH is the most sensitive test of thyroid function.
Гонадотрофы делают <b>ЛГ</b> и <b>ФСГ</b: Gonadotrophs make LH and FSH. They are switched on by gonadoliberin (GnRH), but only in pulses — once every 1–2 hours (flashes in the stream). Continuous GnRH, on the contrary, switches gonadotrophs off — this is how prostate cancer is treated. In men LH drives testosterone synthesis and FSH sperm maturation; in women they run follicle growth and ovulation.
<b>Вазопрессин</b> (АДГ) — пептид из 9 а: Vasopressin (ADH) is a peptide of 9 amino acids (molecule on the right). It is made by neurons of the supraoptic and paraventricular nuclei; granules travel along axons to the posterior lobe. Rising osmolality and falling pressure trigger its release. In the kidney, via the V2 receptor, it inserts aquaporins — urine concentrates; via V1 it constricts vessels.
<b>Окситоцин</b> отличается от вазопресс: Oxytocin is also a nonapeptide that differs from vasopressin by two amino acids (molecule on the right); it is made mainly in the paraventricular nucleus. It is released when the cervix stretches in labor (positive feedback) and during suckling — milk is pushed out of the alveoli. Synthetic oxytocin induces labor and stops bleeding after it.
Клетка <b>собирательной трубки</b> почки: A kidney collecting-duct cell: urine above, blood below. Vasopressin binds the V2 receptor, cAMP rises, and protein kinase A triggers insertion of aquaporin-2 (blue) into the membrane facing the urine; water passes through the cell into the blood (green AQP3/4): urine is concentrated. Without vasopressin the aquaporins go back inside. 1 s = 4 h.
Человек <b>без воды</b>. Вода уходит с д: A person without water. Water leaves with breath, sweat and urine, blood osmolality rises — thirst and vasopressin release switch on. Aquaporins are in the membrane, urine is under a liter a day and dark (up to 1200 mOsm/kg — four times more concentrated than blood). The kidneys can only save water; it can be replaced only by drinking.
<b>Центральный несахарный диабет</b>: ва: Central diabetes insipidus: there is no vasopressin (injury, tumor or surgery near the pituitary). Aquaporins are not inserted, and the kidney passes up to 15–20 L of dilute urine a day. The person is constantly thirsty; without access to water, quickly becomes dehydrated.
<b>СНСАДГ</b> (неадекватная секреция АДГ: SIADH (syndrome of inappropriate ADH secretion): vasopressin is released without need — in tumors (small-cell lung cancer), lung and brain diseases, and from some drugs. The kidney retains water and the blood is diluted: sodium falls (hyponatremia), while urine stays concentrated. Severe hyponatremia means brain edema: headache, confusion, seizures.
<b>Лечение СНСАДГ</b>: ограничить питьё: Treatment of SIADH: limit drinking to 0.8–1 L a day and treat the cause; in severe cases — vaptans (V2 receptor blockers) and careful 3% NaCl. Sodium is raised no faster than 8–10 mmol/L a day, otherwise osmotic demyelination of the brain is possible.
<b>Гормон роста</b> выделяется импульсам: Growth hormone is released in pulses — most of all in deep sleep and in adolescence. It raises blood sugar and burns fat, and tells bones to grow through IGF-1, made by the liver. IGF-1 makes cartilage cells divide in the growth plates (glowing). By 16–18 years sex hormones close them, and growth in length stops.
<b>Акромегалия</b>: аденома появилась у: Acromegaly: an adenoma appeared in an adult (here at 20), when the growth plates are already closed. Bones do not lengthen, but the hands, feet, lower jaw, nose, tongue and organs enlarge. The disease is slow and is noticed after 5–10 years: rings and shoes become too small. Dangerous for diabetes, hypertension and heart disease.
<b>β-клетка</b> — датчик сахара: глюкоза: β-cell — a sugar sensor: glucose enters through GLUT2 (in humans mainly GLUT1), glucokinase starts its use, mitochondria make ATP. ATP closes the K-ATP channel, the cell depolarizes, Ca²⁺ enters — and granules release insulin.
Натощак (≈ 5 ммоль/л) АТФ мало, K-АТФ-ка: Fasting (≈ 5 mmol/L): little ATP, K-ATP channels open, membrane about −65 mV — the cell is silent.

The same channels mutate in neonatal diabetes, and such children are treated with tablets.

<b>Сутки здорового человека</b> (1 с = 1: A healthy person’s day (1 s = 1 h, dots at the bottom of the graph are meals). After a meal sugar rises to 7–8 mmol/L, insulin (blue streams) makes the liver, muscle and fat take up glucose, and within 2 hours sugar returns to 4–6. At night the liver (orange stream) releases glucose from glycogen, and basal insulin keeps it from releasing too much.
<b>Диабет 1 типа</b>: иммунная система р: Type 1 diabetes: the immune system has destroyed the β-cells, no insulin. Sugar climbs to 20–30 mmol/L, glucose is lost in urine and drags water with it. Without insulin fat breaks down unchecked and the liver makes ketones (red glow): ketones above 3 mmol/L and pH below 7.3 mean ketoacidosis (vomiting, deep noisy breathing). Treated with intravenous insulin, fluids and potassium.
<b>Инсулинотерапия</b> заменяет поджелуд: Insulin therapy replaces the pancreas: long-acting (basal) insulin once a day keeps the liver in check, short-acting is taken before meals (injected into subcutaneous fat). The dose is set by the carbohydrates eaten and glucose readings (often with a sensor and pump). An overdose causes hypoglycemia, so its signs must be known.
<b>Диабет 2 типа</b> — 90% случаев. Ткан: Type 2 diabetes — 90% of cases. Tissues respond poorly to insulin (insulin resistance, especially with excess visceral fat), the liver releases extra glucose, and β-cells gradually wear out. Sugar is high all day. The basis of treatment is diet, exercise and weight loss; then tablets and injections. Try the drugs one by one and together.
<b>Глифлозины</b> (дапаглифлозин, эмпагл: Gliflozins (dapagliflozin, empagliflozin) block the SGLT2 transporter in the kidney tubules: the renal glucose threshold falls to 2–4 mmol/L, and 40–80 g of glucose a day leaves in the urine (yellow stream). Sugar falls independently of insulin; they protect the heart and kidneys.
<b>Гликирование</b> — глюкоза сама, без: Glycation — glucose attaches by itself, without an enzyme, to amino groups of proteins: first a reversible Schiff base, then a stable Amadori product. This is how HbA1c arises — hemoglobin with glucose on the N-terminus of the β chain. A red cell lives about 120 days, so HbA1c is the average sugar over 2–3 months: normal is under 5.7%, the usual target in diabetes under 7%.
Average sugar ≈ 12 mmol/L, HbA1c ≈ 9%. Proteins all over the body are glycated; irreversible advanced glycation end products (AGEs) stiffen tissues and cause inflammation. In the lens (right) aldose reductase turns glucose into sorbitol: it draws in water and the fibers cloud — a cataract. Small and large vessels (eyes, kidneys, nerves, heart) are damaged.
<b>Половые стероиды</b> делаются из холе: Sex steroids are made from cholesterol: CYP11A1 gives pregnenolone, CYP17 removes two carbons, and 3β-HSD and 17β-HSD finish the job to testosterone (in humans mostly via DHEA). In men 95% of it is made by Leydig cells in response to LH. In skin and prostate 5α-reductase turns it into the more potent DHT, and aromatase makes estradiol, which bone needs.
В яичнике <b>две клетки, два гормона</b>: The ovary works on two cells, two hormones: theca cells, driven by LH, make androstenedione (they lack aromatase), and granulosa cells, driven by FSH, turn androgens into estrogens: androstenedione → estrone, testosterone → estradiol (aromatase, CYP19). After ovulation the corpus luteum makes progesterone. Estrogens’ ring A is aromatic, like phenol.
До менопаузы эстрадиол падает, ФСГ растё: Before menopause estradiol falls and FSH rises — this is how letrozole induces ovulation.
<b>Летрозол</b> (и анастрозол) блокируют: Letrozole (and anastrozole) block aromatase: estrogens almost disappear and androgens build up. It treats hormone-dependent breast cancer after menopause, when only fat tissue makes estrogens; bones lose calcium.
<b>Финастерид</b> блокирует 5α-редуктазу: Finasteride blocks 5α-reductase type 2: DHT falls by about 70% and testosterone rises slightly. The prostate shrinks — it treats benign prostatic hyperplasia, and at a low dose male-pattern baldness. Without this enzyme boys’ external genitalia develop poorly: they need DHT specifically.
<b>Ось гипоталамус — гипофиз — яички.</b: The hypothalamic–pituitary–testicular axis. The hypothalamus releases GnRH in pulses, the pituitary responds with LH and FSH. LH drives testosterone synthesis in Leydig cells; FSH with testosterone drives sperm maturation in Sertoli cells (which make inhibin, inhibiting FSH). Testosterone inhibits the hypothalamus and pituitary (red arrow).
<b>Анаболические стероиды</b> в больших: Anabolic steroids in high doses: androgens are far above normal and muscles grow. But feedback silences the axis: LH and FSH are almost zero, the testes stop making testosterone, shrink, spermatogenesis stops — infertility, sometimes for years. Also: gynecomastia, acne, baldness, higher hematocrit and blood pressure, lower HDL, liver damage (oral forms).
<b>Вторичный гипогонадизм</b>: гипоталам: Secondary hypogonadism: the hypothalamus or pituitary does not release gonadotropins (tumor, injury, Kallmann syndrome — GnRH neurons did not reach the hypothalamus, often with loss of smell). LH, FSH and testosterone are low, the testes are small. Treated with testosterone or, if fertility is needed, gonadotropins.
<b>Ось гипоталамус — гипофиз — яичники.<: The hypothalamic–pituitary–ovarian axis. FSH grows the follicle and granulosa makes more and more estradiol. Normally it inhibits the pituitary, but when it stays high for about two days the feedback turns positive: the LH surge on day 14 triggers ovulation. The corpus luteum makes progesterone and estradiol, then breaks down.
<b>Комбинированные контрацептивы</b> — э: Combined contraceptives — ethinylestradiol (an estrogen resistant to liver breakdown) + a progestin. A constant hormone level keeps feedback negative: FSH does not grow the follicle, no LH surge — no ovulation. The progestin also thickens cervical mucus. Own estradiol is low; the pill does its job.
<b>Менопауза</b> (в среднем в 51 год): ф: Menopause (on average at 51): the follicles have run out, estradiol and inhibin fall — there is no brake, and FSH and LH are very high. Without estrogens — hot flashes, dry mucous membranes, bone loss (osteoporosis), higher risk of atherosclerosis. Hormone replacement therapy relieves symptoms and is prescribed individually.
<b>Тест на беременность</b> — иммунохром: A pregnancy test is an immunochromatographic strip: urine flows to the right. The conjugate zone holds antibodies to the β subunit of hCG with gold. The test line carries antibodies to the α subunit, the control line antibodies against the conjugates. Without hCG only the control line colors: the test is negative. Above — IgG and a diagram of hCG.
<b>ХГЧ</b> начинает делать трофобласт по: hCG is made by the trophoblast after implantation (6–10 days after conception). It resembles LH (shared α subunit) and keeps the corpus luteum from breaking down until the placenta takes over at week 7–9. hCG doubles every 2–3 days. An “antibody — hCG — antibody” sandwich is held at the test line: a second line (at 25 mIU/mL still faint).
На 8–10-й акушерской неделе (6–8 недель: At gestational weeks 8–10 (6–8 weeks after conception) hCG peaks — up to 100,000 mIU/mL and more, and the test line is bright at once. Rapid COVID and flu tests work the same way. A blood β-hCG test is more precise: from the rate of rise a doctor tells a normal pregnancy from an ectopic one. Very high hCG occurs in multiple and molar pregnancy.
<b>Летрозол и финастерид</b> действуют н: Letrozole and finasteride act on different branches of the pathway: letrozole blocks aromatase (estrogens vanish, androgens build up), finasteride blocks 5α-reductase (DHT falls, testosterone rises slightly).
<b>Кальций крови</b> держится в узких пр: Blood calcium is held in a narrow range (2.2–2.6 mmol/L): nerves, muscles, clotting and the heart depend on it. The sensor is the calcium-sensing receptor of the parathyroid glands (the 4 yellow dots). Calcium dips — parathyroid hormone (PTH) is released: it takes calcium from bone, holds it in the kidneys and tells them to make calcitriol, which boosts absorption in the gut.
<b>Первичный гиперпаратиреоз</b> — чаще: Primary hyperparathyroidism is most often an adenoma of one parathyroid gland that releases PTH regardless of feedback. Calcium is high, phosphate low. The classic: “stones, bones, groans and psychiatric moans” — kidney stones, osteoporosis, abdominal pain, depression. It is often found by chance on a blood test.
<b>Гипопаратиреоз</b> — чаще после опера: Hypoparathyroidism usually follows thyroid surgery that damaged the parathyroids. Without PTH calcium falls and nerves become excitable: tingling around the mouth and in the fingers, hand spasms (“obstetrician’s hand”, red sparks), in severe cases laryngospasm. Treated with intravenous calcium, then calcium and calcitriol.
<b>Витамин D</b> — скорее гормон. В коже: Vitamin D is more a hormone. In the skin 7-dehydrocholesterol under UV-B opens ring B and gives cholecalciferol (D₃). The liver adds OH at position 25 — calcidiol (25-OH-D), the storage form (normal — from 30 ng/mL). The kidneys add OH at position 1: calcitriol, the active hormone; PTH and low phosphate switch it on, FGF23 restrains it, and 24-hydroxylase destroys the excess.
<b>Кость всё время перестраивается</b>:: Bone is constantly remodeled: about 10% of the skeleton is replaced each year. An osteoclast (purple, multinucleated) settles on the bone, releases acid and cathepsin K, and dissolves mineral and collagen — calcium goes into the blood (light-blue sparks). Then osteoblasts (green) lay down collagen, on which hydroxyapatite crystallizes. Bone mass stays constant.
<b>Синтез гема</b> идёт во всех клетках,: Heme synthesis occurs in all cells, most of all in bone marrow and liver. It starts and ends in the mitochondrion: glycine + succinyl-CoA → aminolevulinic acid (ALA synthase, vitamin B₆; the key step). Two ALA → porphobilinogen, four pyrroles → porphyrinogen → protoporphyrin IX, and ferrochelatase inserts Fe²⁺. Turn on the disorders.
<b>Распад гема.</b> Эритроцит живёт ~120: Heme breakdown. A red cell lives ~120 days; about 6 g of hemoglobin is broken down a day. Heme oxygenase opens the heme ring: CO and iron are released. Green biliverdin is reduced to orange bilirubin (250–300 mg a day), which is toxic to the brain. In the liver it becomes “direct” (two glucuronic acids) and leaves with the bile.
<b>Путь билирубина.</b> «Непрямой» билир: Bilirubin pathway. “Indirect” bilirubin from the spleen is carried by albumin. The liver conjugates it and sends it with the bile into the gut, where bacteria make urobilinogen: most becomes stercobilin (the color of stool), a little goes into urine (urobilin). When a step fails, bilirubin builds up in the blood: jaundice (visible above ~35 µmol/L). Choose a type; click an organ for details.
<b>Острая перемежающаяся порфирия</b> —: Acute intermittent porphyria is a deficiency of PBG deaminase. The skin is spared, but neurotoxic ALA and porphobilinogen build up: abdominal pain, psychiatric symptoms, urine darkens in light. Attacks are triggered by barbiturates (P450 inducers), alcohol and fasting. Treated with hemin and glucose, which suppress ALA synthase.
<b>Физиологическая желтуха новорождённых: Physiological jaundice of the newborn (days 2–5): fetal hemoglobin breaks down while the liver’s UDP-glucuronosyltransferase is still immature, so indirect bilirubin rises; kernicterus is the danger (it enters the brain). Treated with phototherapy: blue light (~460 nm) makes water-soluble isomers excreted without conjugation.
<b>pH крови</b> держится в пределах 7,35: Blood pH is kept within 7.35–7.45; below is acidosis, above is alkalosis. The main buffer is bicarbonate: CO₂ + H₂O ⇌ H₂CO₃ ⇌ H⁺ + HCO₃⁻. Both parts are regulated: the lungs exhale CO₂ (minutes), the kidneys hold HCO₃⁻ (days). pH = 6.1 + log([HCO₃⁻] / 0.03·pCO₂); normal — 24 mmol/L to 40 mmHg, i.e. 20 : 1. Other buffers: hemoglobin, proteins, phosphate.
<b>Белки плазмы</b>: 65–85 г/л. При <b>э: Plasma proteins: 65–85 g/L. In electrophoresis they move toward the anode (+) at different speeds and split into 5 fractions: albumins (55–65%) hold oncotic pressure and carry fatty acids, bilirubin, hormones; α₁ (antitrypsin), α₂ (haptoglobin, ceruloplasmin), β (transferrin, LDL), γ — antibodies.
<b>Свёртывание</b> — каскад протеолиза:: Blood clotting is a proteolytic cascade: each activated protease switches on many molecules of the next, so the signal grows thousands of times. The extrinsic pathway starts with tissue factor (VIIa), the intrinsic one with contact with collagen (XII → XI → IX + VIII). Both meet at factor Xa: it makes thrombin, thrombin cuts fibrinogen — fibrin weaves into a mesh.
<b>Печёночная долька</b> — шестигранная: The liver lobule is a hexagonal prism ~1 mm across: the central vein in the middle, portal tracts at the corners (portal vein — purple, hepatic artery — red, bile duct — green). Blood flows through sinusoids between cords of hepatocytes to the central vein, bile flows the opposite way, to the ducts. Hepatocytes are about 60% of liver cells.
<b>Фаза I — окисление.</b> В мембране ЭП: Phase I — oxidation. In the ER membrane: NADPH → flavoprotein (FAD) → cytochrome b5 → P450. P450 (a heme monooxygenase) puts one O₂ atom into benzene (RH → R–OH), the other goes to water; phenol results. Phase II — conjugation: glucuronic acid, sulfate or glutathione make it water-soluble — it leaves in urine or bile.
<b>Обмен этанола.</b> 90–98% окисляется: Ethanol metabolism. 90–98% is oxidized in the liver: alcohol dehydrogenase → acetaldehyde → aldehyde dehydrogenase → acetate → acetyl-CoA; both reactions make NADH. At high doses MEOS (P450 2E1) joins in. The liver oxidizes only ~7–9 g of ethanol per hour. Excess NADH inhibits gluconeogenesis and boosts fat synthesis.
<b>Парацетамол</b> на 90% конъюгируется: Acetaminophen (paracetamol) is 90% conjugated (glucuronide, sulfate); 5–10% is oxidized by P450 2E1 to the reactive NAPQI, which glutathione neutralizes. In an overdose (more than 7–10 g) glutathione runs out and NAPQI binds proteins — liver necrosis. The antidote is N-acetylcysteine (a cysteine source), best within the first 8–10 hours.
<b>Цирроз</b> — итог хронического повреж: Cirrhosis is the outcome of chronic injury (alcohol, viral hepatitis, steatohepatitis): dying hepatocytes are replaced by connective tissue, septa divide the lobules into nodules and disrupt blood flow (portal hypertension, ascites). Albumin and clotting factors fall, ammonia rises (encephalopathy).
Главная химическая фабрика тела: почти в: The body’s main chemical factory: almost everything absorbed in the intestine passes through it first — drugs, alcohol and poisons alike.
<b>Остаточный (небелковый) азот</b> — аз: Residual (non-protein) nitrogen is the nitrogen of everything left in the blood after proteins are precipitated: 14–28 mmol/L. Half is urea (made by the liver from ammonia); the rest is amino acids, uric acid, creatinine (from muscle) and a little ammonia. All of it is filtered in the glomerulus; urea and creatinine leave in the urine, the rest is reabsorbed.
<b>Гидрокарбонатный буфер</b> — главный: The bicarbonate buffer is the main one in extracellular fluid: H⁺ + HCO₃⁻ ⇄ H₂CO₃ ⇄ CO₂ + H₂O. Add acid: the red H⁺ are captured by bicarbonate, carbonic acid breaks down and CO₂ is exhaled by the lungs (bubbles). The system is open, so pH barely changes; the kidneys restore HCO₃⁻. pH = 6.1 + log([HCO₃⁻] / 0.03·pCO₂).
<b>Синтез гликогена.</b> После еды глюко: Glycogen synthesis. After a meal glucose → glucose-6-phosphate → glucose-1-phosphate → UDP-glucose (green sparks). Glycogen synthase attaches residues to the ends of chains with α-1,4 bonds, and the branching enzyme moves pieces of 6–7 residues and creates α-1,6 branch points (every 8–12 residues). The primer is the protein glycogenin (pink). Insulin switches the synthase on.
<b>Распад гликогена.</b> <b>Гликогенфосф: Glycogen breakdown. Glycogen phosphorylase (vitamin B6) cleaves glucose off chain ends with phosphate — straight to glucose-1-phosphate (flying molecules), no ATP spent. The debranching enzyme handles branch points. Epinephrine and glucagon activate it. Liver: glucose-6-phosphatase releases glucose into the blood; muscle: only its own glycolysis.
<b>Сахар крови</b> держится в коридоре ~: Blood sugar is kept within a fasting range of ~3.9–5.5 mmol/L. After a meal it rises → insulin (light blue stream from the β cells) makes the liver and muscles store glucose as glycogen and fat. During fasting it falls → glucagon (orange) makes the liver break down glycogen and synthesize glucose. The brain uses ~120 g of glucose a day. Click “Eat” and compare with diabetes.
<b>Переваривание углеводов.</b> Крахмал: Carbohydrate digestion. Starch is split by salivary amylase and especially pancreatic amylase (light blue drops), disaccharides by brush border enzymes: maltase, sucrase, lactase. Glucose and galactose enter the cell with Na⁺ via SGLT1, fructose via GLUT5, and all exit into the blood via GLUT2. Humans cannot digest fiber.
<b>Лактазная недостаточность.</b> У боль: Lactase deficiency. In most adults worldwide lactase declines after weaning (among Northern Europeans it often persists — a mutation of the dairy-farming era). Undigested lactose passes into the colon: it holds water (diarrhea), and bacteria ferment it into gases and acids — bloating and pain. Fermented dairy products help.
<b>Галактоза и фруктоза</b> в печени ста: Galactose and fructose in the liver become glucose metabolites. Galactose: galactokinase → galactose-1-phosphate → GALT (takes UMP from UDP-glucose) → UDP-galactose; epimerase returns UDP-glucose. Fructose: fructokinase → fructose-1-phosphate → aldolase B → glycolysis, bypassing phosphofructokinase — so an excess goes to fat.
<b>Галактоземия</b> (дефект ГАЛТ, ~1 : 5: Galactosemia (GALT defect, ~1 : 50,000). After milk, the infant has vomiting, jaundice, an enlarged liver and hypoglycemia. Galactose-1-phosphate is toxic to the liver, kidneys and brain; galactitol builds up in the lens — cataract. Treatment: lifelong exclusion of milk and lactose; the disease is in newborn screening.
<b>Скорость реакции</b> растёт с концент: The reaction rate rises with substrate concentration [S] as long as free enzymes are available. When all active sites are occupied (yellow lights), saturation sets in — the rate reaches Vmax. Km is the concentration at which the rate equals ½Vmax: the lower the Km, the more strongly the enzyme “likes” its substrate. The Michaelis–Menten equation: v = Vmax·[S] / (Km + [S]).
<b>Необратимый ингибитор</b> (оранжевые): An irreversible inhibitor (orange) attaches to the enzyme by a covalent bond — the enzyme is out of action for good (dark models). Activity returns only when new enzyme molecules are synthesized. Examples: sarin and organophosphate poisons (cholinesterase), iodoacetamide (SH groups), aspirin (cyclooxygenase), penicillin (bacterial transpeptidase).
<b>Неконкурентный ингибитор</b> (фиолето: A noncompetitive inhibitor (purple) does not resemble the substrate; it binds elsewhere on the enzyme and changes its shape. Excess substrate does not help: Vmax falls, while Km stays the same. Heavy-metal ions act this way on the SH groups of enzymes.
<b>Активные формы кислорода и защита.</b: Reactive oxygen species and their defenses. SOD converts superoxide O₂•⁻ into H₂O₂; catalase and glutathione peroxidase convert H₂O₂ into water. With Fe²⁺, H₂O₂ gives •OH (the Fenton reaction), which triggers lipid peroxidation in the membrane. Vitamin E breaks the chain, and vitamin C regenerates it. Switch off defenses and add stress.
<b>Радикалы как оружие.</b> Нейтрофилы и: Radicals as weapons. Neutrophils and macrophages kill microbes with an “oxidative burst”: NADPH oxidase of the phagosome (orange) produces superoxide, which gives rise to H₂O₂, and myeloperoxidase (green granules) makes hypochlorous acid HOCl from H₂O₂ and chloride — the active ingredient of bleach. Click “Engulf a bacterium”.
<b>Липопротеины</b> — «грузовики» для жи: Lipoproteins are “trucks” for fats in watery blood. On the outside is a layer of phospholipids (heads facing the water) and apolipoproteins (ribbons); inside is the insoluble cargo: triacylglycerols and cholesteryl esters (the front half of the shell is removed). The more fat and the less protein, the larger and lighter the particle. Click a particle.
<b>Пути транспорта.</b> <span style=\"co: Transport routes. Chylomicrons carry dietary fat from the intestine to muscle and adipose tissue: lipoprotein lipase of the capillaries (activated by apoC-II) cleaves off fatty acids, and the liver takes up the remnants. The liver sends out its own fat in VLDL, which shrink into LDL and hand out cholesterol to the tissues. HDL return excess cholesterol to the liver.
<b>Атеросклероз.</b> При избытке ЛПНП (о: Atherosclerosis. When LDL is in excess, the particles (orange) get under the endothelium and become oxidized; macrophages that engulf them turn into foam cells → a plaque that narrows the lumen. Rupture of its cap triggers a thrombus — a heart attack or stroke. HDL (light blue) carry cholesterol away. A statin blocks HMG-CoA reductase (top), and the liver takes up more LDL.
<b>ЛПВП</b> (высокой плотности, 5–12 нм): HDL (high-density, 5–12 nm) are half protein (apoA-I). They are born in the liver and intestine as flat discs (on the right is a real model: two rings of apoA-I around a patch of bilayer), collect cholesterol from cells and vessels; the enzyme LCAT converts it into esters, and the particle becomes a sphere. The cholesterol goes to the liver — reverse transport.
<b>Хиломикроны</b> — самые крупные (75–1: Chylomicrons are the largest (75–1200 nm; shrunk 4× in the model) and the lightest particles: 85–90% of their content is dietary triacylglycerols. They are assembled in intestinal cells and enter the lymph, then the blood. Proteins: apoB-48, apoC-II, apoE. After a fatty meal the plasma stays cloudy (“chylous”) for several hours.
<b>Синтез жира</b> идёт в печени, жирово: Fat synthesis takes place in the liver, adipose tissue and intestine. The backbone is glycerol 3-phosphate (in adipose tissue — only from glucose, in the liver also from glycerol). Two acyl-CoA → phosphatidic acid; a phosphatase → diacylglycerol; a third acyl-CoA → triacylglycerol. The liver packs it into VLDL, adipose tissue stores it in a droplet. Synthesis is switched on by insulin.
<b>Фосфолипиды</b> — из тех же предшеств: Phospholipids come from the same precursors. DAG + CDP-choline → phosphatidylcholine (PC), + CDP-ethanolamine → phosphatidylethanolamine (PE); in the liver PE can become PC (three methyl groups from SAM). CDP-DAG gives phosphatidylinositol. The liver needs PC for the VLDL coat, which is why choline, methionine, B12 and folate are lipotropic factors.
<b>Жировая ткань</b> — главное хранилище: Adipose tissue is the main energy store (1 kg of fat ≈ 7700 kcal). After a meal insulin switches on capillary lipoprotein lipase and fat synthesis; during fasting and exercise epinephrine triggers lipolysis. With a calorie surplus adipocytes grow and multiply; overloaded cells become inflamed (macrophages are purple) and insulin resistance develops.
<b>Механика дыхания.</b> Лёгкие сами не: Mechanics of breathing. The lungs do not contract by themselves: they follow the chest wall. The diaphragm descends, the ribs rise — the pressure in the lungs falls below atmospheric, and air flows in. The rhythm is set by the respiratory center of the medulla oblongata.
